keyTransfer.description: Declared in the ack to a test message. Narrows the keys the registrar sends in create_tenant messages. Unknown values are ignored.

algorithms.description: The key algorithms the receiver imports. Defaults to ["SECP256K1"].

encodings.description: The key encodings the receiver reads. Keys are always sent as JWKs. Leaving out "hex" stops SECP256K1 keys being sent as hex too. Defaults to ["hex", "jwk"].
